payload.reason: The evidence explicitly states that the model calculates both radiative forcing and effective radiative forcing, including adjustments for aerosol-cloud interactions and aerosol-radiation interactions.

claims.text: The model calculates effective radiative forcing that includes adjustments for aerosol-cloud interactions.
The model is able to diagnose both all-sky and clear-sky aerosol radiative forcing, which includes aerosol-cloud interactions.
Clear-sky radiative forcing may include contributions from aerosol-radiation interactions, but is not solely attributed to them.
